title: Normalized degree-one symmetric Proj quotient and affine descent
statement: For every scheme S and arbitrary quasi-coherent O_S-module E, let A be its canonical symmetric graded algebra and p:Proj_S A -> S. There exists a TautologicalQuotient D as defined in def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data: an invertible module Q on Proj_S A, an epi p*E -> Q, and affine charts identifying Q with the actual absolute twist A(U)(1), carrying m to iota(m)/1. For each inclusion U <= V of affine base opens there exists an isomorphism from the pullback of the twist over V to the twist over U. It is the composite determined by the two specified charts of Q and the canonical pullback composition comparison; it carries the pulled morphism unitToTwist(a), for every a in A(V)_1, to unitToTwist(res(a)), using the canonical identification of the pulled unit with the unit. No finite-generation, reducedness, nonzero-ring, or separation assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Obtain the affine comparison family and its chart compatibility from the split affine-comparison theorem. For each affine inclusion, apply the split section-compatibility theorem and package the three fields into NormalizedAffineRestriction.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01NR, 01OB and 01N2; Lean decomposition of the affine descent proof

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalized_quotient_with_affine_restriction
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E,
      ∀ (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V),
        Nonempty (NormalizedAffineRestriction E D U V h)
